messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
അങ്ങനെ എന്നെ ശാന്തിയില്ലാത്ത മൃഗമാക്കി, അത്, എനിക്ക് എതിരായി വരികയും, ക്രമേണ എന്നെ പിന്നോട്ട് തള്ളിയിരുന്നു അവിടെ സൂര്യൻ മൌനമായിടത്ത്.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | **tal** | “such” (demonstrative) | **അങ്ങനെ** | “so / thus” | OK | | **mi** | 1st‑person singular object | **എന്നെ** | “me” | OK | | **fece** | causative “made” | **മൃഗമാക്കി** | “made (into) a beast” | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” | – (omitted) | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **bestia** | “beast” | **മൃഗം** (contained in **മൃഗമാക്കി**) | “beast” | OK | | **sanza** | preposition “without” | **ശാന്തിയില്ലാത്ത** | “without peace” | OK | | **pace** | “repose / peace” | **ശാന്തി** (within **ശാന്തിയില്ലാത്ത**) | “peace” | OK | | **che** | relative pronoun “that” | **അത്** | “that” | OK | | **venendomi** | gerund “coming on (to) me” | **വരികയും** | “coming (to) me” | OK | | **'ncontro** | preposition “against” | **എതിരായി** | “against” | OK | | **a** (1st) | part of idiom “a poco a poco” (incremental) | – (merged) | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **poco** (1st) | “little” (degree) | – (merged) | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **a** (2nd) | part of idiom “a poco a poco” | – (merged) | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **poco** (2nd) | “little” (degree) | – (merged) | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **mi** (line 60) | 1st‑person singular object | **എന്നെ** | “me” | OK | | **ripigneva** | imperfect “was pushing back” | **തള്ളിയിരുന്നു** | “was pushing” | OK | | **là** | adverb of place “there” | **അവിടെ** | “there” | OK | | **dove** | relative adverb “where” | **മൌനമായിടത്ത്** (contains “where”) | “where” | OK | | **'l** | definite article “the” | – (omitted) | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **sol** | noun “Sun” | **സൂര്യൻ** | “Sun” | OK | | **tace** | verb “is silent” | **മൌനമായിടത്ത്** (contains “silent”) | “silent” | OK |
---
### Issues Detected - **UNNECESSARY**: Articles **la** and **'l** are omitted in Malayalam (natural, no loss of meaning). - **UNNECESSARY**: The four particles **a, poco, a, poco** are absorbed into the single Malayalam adverb **ക്രമേണ**; they do not appear as separate words. - **GRAMMAR / PUNCTUATION**: Line 59 in the Malayalam output lacks the required trailing comma (the source line ends with a comma). This is a punctuation error.
No **MISSING** or **WRONG** lexical items were found; all source meanings are represented in the target translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 58: - Original: tal mi fece la bestia sanza pace, - Issue: none - Corrected: അങ്ങനെ എന്നെ ശാന്തിയില്ലാത്ത മൃഗമാക്കി, - Line 59: - Original: che, venendomi 'ncontro, a poco a poco - Issue: missing commas and missing verb “coming on” - Corrected: അത്, എനിക്ക് എതിരായി വരികയും, ക്രമേണ - Line 60: - Original: mi ripigneva là dove 'l sol tace. - Issue: none - Corrected: എന്നെ പിന്നോട്ട് തള്ളിയിരുന്നു അവിടെ സൂര്യൻ മൌനമായിടത്ത്.
